def main( data_dir: str | pathlib._local.Path = PosixPath('/tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/05c6a7c8-2008-5e3f-b679-967f0bb2952e/scratchpad/DATA'), output_dir: str | pathlib._local.Path = PosixPath('/tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/05c6a7c8-2008-5e3f-b679-967f0bb2952e/scratchpad/outputs'), tune: bool = True) -> dict: 
1786def main(data_dir: str | Path = DEFAULT_DATA_DIR, output_dir: str | Path = DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR,
1787         tune: bool = True) -> dict:
1788    """
1789    Run the full occupancy-modelling pipeline and save every output.
1790
1791    Parameters
1792    ----------
1793    data_dir : str or pathlib.Path, optional
1794        Folder containing the occupancy CSV, environmental CSV and registry.
1795    output_dir : str or pathlib.Path, optional
1796        Folder for the output tables (CSV) and figures (``figures/*.png``).
1797        Created if it does not exist.
1798    tune : bool, optional
1799        Tune the Random Forest (takes a few minutes). Defaults to True.
1800
1801    Returns
1802    -------
1803    dict
1804        Key results: ``final_model_name``, ``final_model``, ``comparison``,
1805        ``sensitivity``, ``ranking``, ``predictions`` and ``features``.
1806
1807    Raises
1808    ------
1809    FileNotFoundError
1810        If any input file is missing from ``data_dir``.
1811    ValueError
1812        If an input file is missing required columns or contains no usable data.
1813
1814    Notes
1815    -----
1816    Files written to ``output_dir``:
1817
1818    - ``predicted_headcount.csv``: prediction for every environmental reading,
1819      with flags for readings outside the training period or range.
1820    - ``model_performance_metrics.csv``: RMSE, MAE, R^2, run time and size.
1821    - ``sensitivity_analysis_results.csv``: leave-one-feature-out results.
1822    - ``split_sensitivity_results.csv``: accuracy vs train/test split.
1823    - ``feature_importance_ranking.csv``: ranking of the variables.
1824    - ``rf_tuning_cv_results.csv``: cross-validation results for every
1825      Random Forest setting (only when ``tune=True``).
1826    - ``stage_timings.csv``: wall-clock time of each pipeline stage.
1827    - ``performance_summary.csv``: alignment run times (final vs original
1828      method), estimated operations and arithmetic intensity, and operations
1829      per prediction for each model.
1830    - ``figures/*.png``: time series, correlation heatmap, polynomial fit,
1831      predicted vs actual, tree convergence (``tune=True``), sensitivity and
1832      predictions over time.
1833
1834    Examples
1835    --------
1836    From the command line, in the project root::
1837
1838        python src/occupancy_model.py
1839        python src/occupancy_model.py --no-tune
1840
1841    From Python:
1842
1843    >>> results = main(tune=False)  # doctest: +SKIP
1844    >>> results["final_model_name"]  # doctest: +SKIP
1845    'Random Forest'
1846    """
1847    data_dir, output_dir = Path(data_dir), Path(output_dir)
1848    fig_dir = output_dir / "figures"
1849    fig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1850    start = time.perf_counter()
1851    stage_times = {}
1852    mark = time.perf_counter()
1853
1854    def record(stage: str) -> None:
1855        """Store the time since the previous stage finished."""
1856        nonlocal mark
1857        now = time.perf_counter()
1858        stage_times[stage] = now - mark
1859        mark = now
1860
1861    # 1. Load data
1862    occupancy = load_occupancy(data_dir / OCCUPANCY_FILE)
1863    environment = load_environmental(data_dir / ENVIRONMENT_FILE)
1864    registry = load_sensor_registry(data_dir / REGISTRY_FILE)
1865    location = registry.loc[registry["ID_str"] == str(ENV_SENSOR_ID), ["Building", "Floor/Room", "Area"]]
1866    if not location.empty:
1867        logger.info("Sensor %s is registered in: %s", ENV_SENSOR_ID, location.iloc[0].to_dict())
1868    record("Load and parse data")
1869
1870    # 2. Align and split
1871    readings, dataset, features = build_modelling_dataset(occupancy, environment)
1872    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = split_dataset(dataset, features)
1873    logger.info("Training readings: %d | test readings: %d", len(X_train), len(X_test))
1874    record("Align and split")
1875
1876    # 3. Baseline and alternative models
1877    models = {
1878        "Polynomial Regression (Deg 2)": make_polynomial_model(degree=2),
1879        "Random Forest": make_random_forest(n_estimators=100),
1880        "Gradient Boosting": make_gradient_boosting(),
1881    }
1882    for model in models.values():
1883        model.fit(X_train, y_train)
1884    record("Train baseline and alternative models")
1885
1886    # 4. Tune the Random Forest
1887    if tune:
1888        n_trees, convergence = select_n_trees(X_train, y_train)
1889        plot_tree_convergence(convergence, n_trees, fig_dir / "rf_tree_convergence.png")
1890        models["Random Forest (Tuned)"], cv_results = tune_random_forest(X_train, y_train, n_trees)
1891        cv_results.to_csv(output_dir / "rf_tuning_cv_results.csv", index=False)
1892        record("Tune Random Forest")
1893
1894    # 5. Compare and select the final model
1895    comparison, test_predictions = compare_models(models, X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test, fit=False)
1896    final_name, final_model = select_final_model(comparison, models)
1897    comparison["Role"] = comparison["Model"].map(
1898        lambda m: "Baseline" if m.startswith("Polynomial") else "Final model" if m == final_name else "Alternative")
1899    comparison.to_csv(output_dir / "model_performance_metrics.csv", index=False)
1900    logger.info("Final model: %s\n%s", final_name, comparison.round(4).to_string(index=False))
1901    record("Compare models (including repeated timing runs)")
1902
1903    # Performance analysis: alignment timing, operation counts, arithmetic intensity
1904    performance = performance_summary(occupancy, environment, models, X_test)
1905    performance.to_csv(output_dir / "performance_summary.csv", index=False)
1906    logger.info("Performance summary:\n%s", performance.to_string(index=False))
1907    record("Performance analysis")
1908
1909    # 6. Sensitivity analysis and feature ranking
1910    split_results = split_sensitivity(final_model, dataset[features], dataset["avg_headcount"])
1911    split_results.to_csv(output_dir / "split_sensitivity_results.csv", index=False)
1912    sensitivity, baseline = leave_one_feature_out(final_model, X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test)
1913    sensitivity.to_csv(output_dir / "sensitivity_analysis_results.csv", index=False)
1914    ranking = rank_features(final_model, sensitivity, X_train, y_train)
1915    ranking.to_csv(output_dir / "feature_importance_ranking.csv", index=False)
1916    logger.info("Feature ranking:\n%s", ranking[["Overall rank", "Variable"]].to_string(index=False))
1917    record("Sensitivity analyses and ranking")
1918
1919    # 7. Predict headcount for every reading
1920    predictions = predict_headcount(final_model, readings, features,
1921                                    train_times=dataset.loc[X_train.index, "time"],
1922                                    test_times=dataset.loc[X_test.index, "time"],
1923                                    train_features=X_train)
1924    predictions.to_csv(output_dir / "predicted_headcount.csv", index=False)
1925    unlabelled = predictions[predictions["split"] == "unlabelled"]
1926    logger.info("Unlabelled readings: %d | outside training period: %d | outside training range: %d",
1927                len(unlabelled), unlabelled["outside_training_period"].sum(),
1928                unlabelled["outside_training_range"].sum())
1929    record("Predict headcount")
1930
1931    # 8. Figures
1932    plot_time_series(dataset, features, fig_dir / "time_series.png")
1933    plot_correlation_heatmap(X_train, y_train, fig_dir / "correlation_heatmap.png")
1934    plot_polynomial_fit(X_train, y_train, y_test, test_predictions["Polynomial Regression (Deg 2)"],
1935                        fig_dir / "polynomial_fit.png")
1936    plot_predicted_vs_actual(y_test, test_predictions, fig_dir / "predicted_vs_actual.png")
1937    plot_sensitivity(sensitivity, final_name, fig_dir / "sensitivity_analysis.png")
1938    plot_predictions(predictions, final_name, fig_dir / "predicted_headcount_time_series.png")
1939    record("Figures")
1940    timings = pd.DataFrame({"stage": list(stage_times), "time_s": list(stage_times.values())})
1941    timings.to_csv(output_dir / "stage_timings.csv", index=False)
1942    logger.info("Stage timings:\n%s", timings.round(2).to_string(index=False))
1943
1944    logger.info("Strongest predictor of occupancy: %s", ranking.loc[0, "Variable"])
1945    logger.info("Finished in %.0f s. Outputs saved to %s", time.perf_counter() - start, output_dir.resolve())
1946    return {"final_model_name": final_name, "final_model": final_model, "comparison": comparison,
1947            "sensitivity": sensitivity, "ranking": ranking, "predictions": predictions, "features": features}

Run the full occupancy-modelling pipeline and save every output.

Parameters
  • data_dir (str or pathlib.Path, optional): Folder containing the occupancy CSV, environmental CSV and registry.
  • output_dir (str or pathlib.Path, optional): Folder for the output tables (CSV) and figures (figures/*.png). Created if it does not exist.
  • tune (bool, optional): Tune the Random Forest (takes a few minutes). Defaults to True.
Returns
  • dict: Key results: final_model_name, final_model, comparison, sensitivity, ranking, predictions and features.
Raises
  • FileNotFoundError: If any input file is missing from data_dir.
  • ValueError: If an input file is missing required columns or contains no usable data.
Notes

Files written to output_dir:

  • predicted_headcount.csv: prediction for every environmental reading, with flags for readings outside the training period or range.
  • model_performance_metrics.csv: RMSE, MAE, R^2, run time and size.
  • sensitivity_analysis_results.csv: leave-one-feature-out results.
  • split_sensitivity_results.csv: accuracy vs train/test split.
  • feature_importance_ranking.csv: ranking of the variables.
  • rf_tuning_cv_results.csv: cross-validation results for every Random Forest setting (only when tune=True).
  • stage_timings.csv: wall-clock time of each pipeline stage.
  • performance_summary.csv: alignment run times (final vs original method), estimated operations and arithmetic intensity, and operations per prediction for each model.
  • figures/*.png: time series, correlation heatmap, polynomial fit, predicted vs actual, tree convergence (tune=True), sensitivity and predictions over time.
Examples

From the command line, in the project root::

python src/occupancy_model.py
python src/occupancy_model.py --no-tune

From Python:

>>> results = main(tune=False)  # doctest: +SKIP
>>> results["final_model_name"]  # doctest: +SKIP
'Random Forest'
